ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-15-2007 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of TWO Minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Dave Davenport.
Clifford Wang, Esq. for Petitioner: Chun Mei Tam, present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Chun Kit Yung and Man Kit Yung, was sworn and examined.
Order granting Petitioner's request to Dispense with Notice signed in court.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Jason Chun Yung and Michael Man Yung.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-01-2007 Reset To Mar-15-07 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of TWO minors.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Ron Sinclair.
Clifford Wang, Esq. for Petitioner: Chun Mei Tam, present as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Chun Kit Yung and Man Kit Yung, was sworn and examined.
Lacks the Minor's Father consent and proof of service on notice, the OSC for Change of Name of the Minors is continued to Mar. 15, 2007 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.
Petitioner to submit proof of service to the Minor's father of the new hearing date or an Application for an Order dispensing with notice.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
The Court waived the appearance of the minors at the next hearing date.
